metadata.title: Open WebUI v0.11.0 upstream sync
metadata.description: Integrate Open WebUI v0.11.0 into Airis with migration, regression, backup, rollout, and rollback verification.
objectives: Preserve Airis billing, authentication, deployment, and branding behavior.
Integrate the official v0.11.0 stable tag with minimal conflict-resolution overrides.
Validate migrations and application behavior before a backed-up production rollout.
assumptions: origin/airis_b2c at cd51aefb6 is the current integration and production baseline.
v0.11.0 at f9590b801 is the requested official stable target.
The user approved manual SDD JSON lifecycle operations because the local sdd CLI is unavailable.

revision_history.author: Codex
revision_history.changelog: Created active upstream sync specification using the approved manual fallback.

metadata.purpose: Safely update the Airis fork and production deployment to Open WebUI v0.11.0.
Confirm the stable target and isolate work from the dirty production checkout.

metadata.details: Recorded Airis cd51aefb6 and upstream v0.11.0 f9590b801, release status, migration scope, and overlap.

task-1-2.title: Create isolated worktree and workflow artifacts

metadata.details: Created a dedicated branch/worktree, work-item spec, SDD fallback, and branch update without touching the dirty integration checkout.

metadata.purpose: Merge the stable upstream tag and resolve overlapping Airis behavior.

metadata.details: Perform a no-commit merge from v0.11.0 and inventory all conflicts before editing resolutions.

task-2-2.title: Resolve conflicts and preserve Airis hooks

metadata.details: Resolve each conflict at the smallest boundary and document upstream-owned files requiring Airis changes.

metadata.purpose: Validate migration graph, dependencies, build, lint, tests, and Airis regressions.

metadata.details: Produce a compatible dependency set and one Alembic head, then rehearse upgrade against disposable PostgreSQL data.

task-3-2.title: Run Docker build, tests, lint, and focused regressions

metadata.details: Run the repository Docker Compose test matrix and focused billing/auth/chat/deployment checks.

metadata.purpose: Protect production state, deploy the verified image, and prove runtime behavior.

task-4-1.title: Create and verify production rollback backup

metadata.details: Create a checksummed PostgreSQL dump and record source, image, Compose, and container state before migration.

task-4-2.title: Deploy and run production smoke checks

metadata.details: Rebuild/recreate services, verify health/version/logs, and run focused auth/model/chat/billing smoke checks.

metadata.purpose: Close workflow documentation with exact verification and rollback evidence.

metadata.details: Record conflicts, verification, deployment evidence, rollback location, and complete the manual SDD lifecycle.
